authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Each activation costs four colored mana.
Spell-based combo opponents give no targets.
Removal on Tetsuo shuts off the deck.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Mana Drain, Counterspell, Terminate, Withering Torment, Chaos Warp, Damnation, Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift, Vandalblast.
value.mana: 36 land-capable slots with heavy colored sources for {U}{B}{B}{R}.
value.protection: Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Force of Will.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Tetsuo's activation is the deck's repeatable removal, and the untap suite exists to reuse it.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native control. The one Spellbook combo (283-4091, Illusionist's Bracers + Aphetto Alchemist) gives infinite untaps but no mana, so Tetsuo still pays {U}{B}{B}{R} per activation. There is no compact kill; the deck wins by grinding and combat. The source calls Tetsuo mana-intensive and board-dependent (blueprint L43).
